body: Spec at docs2/specs/DISPLAY_FULLSCREEN_SPEC.md. Engine is fully hardcoded to 1280x720 windowed: SDL_CreateWindow hardcoded (line 6359), 6 hardcoded 2D ortho projections, 3D aspect ratio hardcoded. Solution: virtual canvas letterboxing via glViewport (zero changes to HUD code), SDL_WINDOW_FULLSCREEN_DESKTOP borderless fullscreen, Alt+Enter toggle, display.cfg persistence, mouse remap for lobby UI. Added as BLOCKING item to NORTHSTAR Milestone 5. Commit a2b01ee SHANKPIT master.
